# Investor.gov

> SEC's investor education platform providing comprehensive resources on investment basics, fraud prevention, financial planning, and investor protection.

Investor.gov is maintained by the SEC's Office of Investor Education and Assistance (OIEA) to help individuals understand securities, make informed investment decisions, and protect themselves from fraud. The site offers guides, tools, and alerts covering stocks, bonds, mutual funds, ETFs, retirement planning, and working with investment professionals.

## Key Topics

- SEC (U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission)
- Investment Basics
- Fraud Prevention
- Investor Protection
- Stocks and Bonds
- Mutual Funds and ETFs
- Asset Allocation and Diversification
- Investment Fees
- Financial Planning
- Risk Tolerance
- 529 Plans
- EDGAR Database
- Investment Professionals
- Investor Alerts and Bulletins
- Retirement Planning

## Getting Started with Investing

- [Introduction to Investing](https://www.investor.gov/introduction-investing): Beginner's guide to stocks, bonds, and securities investment basics from the SEC.
- [Five Questions to Ask Before You Invest](https://www.investor.gov/introduction-investing/getting-started/five-questions-ask-you-invest): SEC guide covering five critical questions and research steps before investing.
- [Save and Invest](https://www.investor.gov/introduction-investing/investing-basics/save-and-invest): Steps to define and meet financial goals through saving and investing.
- [Invest For Your Goals](https://www.investor.gov/introduction-investing/investing-basics/invest-your-goals): Guide to investment planning for retirement, education, and financial goals.

## Investment Fundamentals

- [Investment Products](https://www.investor.gov/introduction-investing/investing-basics/investment-products): Overview of investment products including stocks, bonds, mutual funds, and ETFs.
- [What is Risk?](https://www.investor.gov/introduction-investing/investing-basics/what-risk): Explanation of investment risk types, volatility, and risk-return relationships.
- [Asset Allocation and Diversification](https://www.investor.gov/introduction-investing/getting-started/asset-allocation): SEC guide on asset allocation, diversification, and portfolio rebalancing strategies.
- [Understanding Fees](https://www.investor.gov/introduction-investing/getting-started/understanding-fees): Guide to investment fees impact on mutual funds, ETFs, and portfolio value.

## Investor Guidance & Research

- [Investing on Your Own](https://www.investor.gov/introduction-investing/getting-started/investing-your-own): Guide for self-directed investors covering financial planning and risk assessment.
- [Working with an Investment Professional](https://www.investor.gov/introduction-investing/getting-started/working-investment-professional): Guide to selecting investment advisors, Form CRS, and broker-dealer verification.
- [Researching Investments](https://www.investor.gov/introduction-investing/getting-started/researching-investments): Guide to investment research using SEC EDGAR, EMMA, and disclosure documents.

## Fraud Prevention & Investor Protection

- [Investor Alerts and Bulletins](https://www.investor.gov/introduction-investing/general-resources/news-alerts/alerts-bulletins): SEC investor alerts and bulletins on fraud warnings and scam prevention.

## Reference & Education Resources

- [Glossary](https://www.investor.gov/introduction-investing/investing-basics/glossary): Comprehensive glossary of investing terms, retirement plans, and financial definitions.
- [The Role of the SEC](https://www.investor.gov/introduction-investing/investing-basics/role-sec): Overview of SEC's three-part mission and securities law enforcement role.
- [Spanish Information](https://www.investor.gov/informacion-en-espanol): Spanish-language investor education resources and financial tools from the SEC.

## About & Support

- [Home](https://www.investor.gov): SEC's investor.gov homepage covering investment basics, fraud prevention, and financial planning.
- [About Us](https://www.investor.gov/about-us): About SEC's Office of Investor Education and Assistance and investor.gov mission.
- [Contact Us](https://www.investor.gov/contact-us): Contact information for SEC's Office of Investor Education and Assistance.

## Optional

- [Follow Us](https://www.investor.gov/follow-us): Social media and email subscription links for SEC news and investor updates.
